info.title: pacod-broker
info.description: Discovery of AI and compute resources, with prices and availability over time and reputation for providers and clients. The public API is on BROKER_LISTEN, the admin API (/api/v1) on BROKER_ADMIN_LISTEN.

put.summary: Announce a provider's resources under a lease

post.summary: Keep a lease alive and report live status

get.summary: Prices in force, in pacod-gw's price feed format

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217; the first resource's when absent

post.summary: Report how calls went, with tickets
Rate a resource, with a ticket
A provider's report about a client

get.summary: Who the caller is and what they may do
One resource with its lease and reputation evidence
Prices and availability over a span

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: RFC 3339; seven days later by default

get.summary: One provider with its leases and reputation evidence

post.summary: Block a provider and end its leases
Vouch for a provider, or stop

put.summary: Add or replace a provider's static entries

post.summary: freeze, unfreeze or reset a score
Take back an unfounded client report

ttl_s.description: Seconds the lease lasts without a heartbeat. The broker's default when absent.

lease_id.description:
Replace the resources of this lease (after a provider restarts with its lease id kept);
otherwise a new lease is opened.

Announcement.description: What a provider sends to announce.

name.description: A slug naming the provider. In `open` mode it also identifies the provider.

title.description: A display name, plain text. Defaults to the resource's name.

summary.description: One line of plain text, at most 200 characters.

description.description: Markdown, at most `BROKER_MAX_DESCRIPTION_BYTES` (16 KiB by default).

examples.description: Usage snippets: how to call the resource.

contact.description: How to reach a person: an email address or a URL.

locations.description: Regions or ISO 3166 country codes the provider operates in.

ProviderProfile.description: What a provider says about itself when it announces.

language.description: The language of the snippet, for highlighting: `bash`, `python`, `json`, …

Translation.description: A translation of the summary and description.

assurance.description: Always `declared` today; `attested` is reserved for checked claims.

Certification.description: A certification the provider declares (ISO 27001, SOC 2, …).

Assurance.description: Whether anyone but the provider has checked a claim.

visibility.description: Who may see the inventory. It never widens the provider's resources' visibility.

Inventory.description: The hardware and software the provider runs on.

id.description: A slug unique within the inventory, for resources to point at.

model.description: The model as the vendor names it: `H100-SXM`, `MI300X`, `EPYC 9654`.

memory_gb.description: Memory per unit, in GB: a GPU's memory, or the size of a memory or storage item.

HardwareItem.description: One kind of hardware, `count` of it.

id.description: A slug unique within the inventory, for resources to point at.

version.description: A version; semantic versions (`0.7.3`, `12.6`) can be filtered with ranges.

key.description:
The provider's own key for the resource, a slug unique among its resources. The
resource's id is derived from it, so it stays the same across announcements.

name.description: A slug naming what is served: the model id, the server's name.

title.description: A display name, plain text. Defaults to the resource's name.

summary.description: One line of plain text, at most 200 characters.

description.description: Markdown, at most `BROKER_MAX_DESCRIPTION_BYTES` (16 KiB by default).

examples.description: Usage snippets: how to call the resource.

ResourceSpec.description: What a provider announces for one resource.

spec_url.description: A machine-readable description: an OpenAPI document, an A2A agent card.

obtain_url.description: Where to get credentials: a sign-up page, a token endpoint.

oneOf.description: A pacod-id token: the caller's own, or a service account's.

upstream_id.description: The id the upstream provider uses.

mcp_tools.description: For MCP servers: the tools they offer.

accelerator.description: For compute: the accelerator, its memory and how many.

RunsOn.description: The inventory items a resource runs on, by their ids in the provider's inventory.

free.description: The resource costs nothing. Then no period is needed.

timezone.description: The zone the windows' times are in.

TimeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Sofia or UTC.

valid_to.description: Open when absent: valid until the next period starts.

Rates.description: Rates, each optional. Token rates are per million tokens; the others per unit named.

weekdays.description: The days the window starts on; empty means every day.

PriceWindow.description: A recurring variant within a period.

PriceOverride.description: A one-off price for an absolute span.

Tier.description: A volume price: the rates for usage above `above` units within `per` (a month by default).

Commitment.description: A reserved price for a commitment of at least `min_hours`.

status.description: The status when announced. Heartbeats change it without a new announcement.

regions.description: Regions the resource is served from (slugs: `eu-central`, `bg`, `us-east-1`).

latency.description: Declared latency. What callers observe goes into reputation, not here.

oneOf.description: Usable, but slower or less reliable than usual.
Finishing what runs, taking nothing new.

max_concurrency.description: Concurrent requests, sessions or units the resource can take.

unit.description: What one unit is: `requests`, `sessions`, `gpus`. Requests by default.

ttft_ms.description: Time to the first token or byte, in milliseconds.

ms_per_token.description: Milliseconds per output token after the first.

weekdays.description: The days the window starts on; empty means every day.

Rule.description:
Opening hours: on these weekdays, between these times, the resource is available (with an
optional capacity) or not.

announced_at.description:
When the broker first saw this window. Set by the broker; reputation counts maintenance
announced well ahead as planned, not as an outage.

Slot.description: Bookable capacity for an absolute span.

oneOf.description: Probably available; the provider has not confirmed it.

training_use.description: Whether inputs may be used to train models.

residency.description: Where the data is processed: regions or ISO 3166 codes (`eu`, `bg`).

classification.description:
The highest data classification the resource accepts: `public`, `internal`,
`confidential`, `restricted`.

Policy.description: What happens to the data sent to the resource.

min_client_reputation.description: Clients with a lower reputation do not see the resource.

allow_new_clients.description: Clients still too new to have a reputation (confidence below 0.3) see it anyway.

heartbeat_every_s.description: When to send the next heartbeat: a third of the lease.

resources.description: The id of each resource, by key.

errors.description: For `invalid`: every problem found, each `path: message`.

resources.description: Per resource, by key: the same fields for one resource.

kind.description:
The kind. Needed when sorting by price, latency or reputation: those only compare within
one kind.

q.description: Words to search for in names, titles, summaries, descriptions and tags.

protocols.description: At least one of these protocols.

regions.description: Served from at least one of these regions.

residency.description: Data processed only in these places: every place the resource lists must be one of them.

max_price.description:
The highest acceptable value of each rate, by rate name (`input`, `per_gpu_hour`, …), at
`at`, or as the time-weighted mean over `during`.

include_unpriced.description: Keep resources that have no price for a rate `max_price` names. Off by default.

currency.description:
Only resources priced in this currency (ISO 4217), and free ones. The broker converts
no currency: a price sort or a maximum price compares numbers, so give the currency
whenever prices in several currencies may be listed.

at.description: The instant prices and availability are evaluated at; now by default.

during.description: A span to evaluate prices and availability over, instead of an instant.

include_unavailable.description: Also return resources that are not available at `at` (or during `during`).

min_reputation.description: The lowest acceptable reputation score of the resource, 0 to 1.

min_confidence.description:
With `min_reputation`: the lowest confidence. Resources with less evidence are left out
unless this is 0.

Span.description: An absolute span of time, `from` inclusive, `to` exclusive.

min_capacity.description: The capacity needed (in the resource's unit). Without it any capacity will do.

coverage.description: Over a span: available all of it (`full`, the default) or some of it (`any`).

exclude_degraded.description: Leave out resources whose live status is `degraded`.

gpu_model.description: A GPU model, as the provider names it, any case: `H100-SXM`, `MI300X`.

min_gpus.description: The number of GPUs of one item (one machine type), at least.

min_memory_gb.description: Some memory item of at least this size, in GB.

price.description: The price at `at`, when the query asked for an instant.

price_summary.description: The prices over `during`, when the query asked for a span.

why.description: Why it matched and what it was ranked by.

ticket.description: Proof that this client was shown this resource now: quote it in usage reports and ratings.

key.description:
The provider's own key for the resource, a slug unique among its resources. The
resource's id is derived from it, so it stays the same across announcements.

name.description: A slug naming what is served: the model id, the server's name.

title.description: A display name, plain text. Defaults to the resource's name.

summary.description: One line of plain text, at most 200 characters.

description.description: Markdown, at most `BROKER_MAX_DESCRIPTION_BYTES` (16 KiB by default).

examples.description: Usage snippets: how to call the resource.

origin.description: The broker the record was announced on.

ResourceRecord.description: A resource as the broker holds it.

oneOf.description: Announced by a provider under a lease: soft state.
From the catalogue file or the admin API: kept across restarts.

ProviderSummary.description: A provider, briefly, as it appears with each resource.

EffectivePrice.description: The price in effect at one instant.

changes.description: The instants at which the effective price changes, with the source from then on.

unpriced_share.description: The share of the span with no price at all (before the first period, between periods).

PriceSummary.description:
The prices over a span: each rate's lowest, highest and time-weighted mean, and when they
change.

available_share.description: The share of the span with at least the capacity asked (any capacity when none was asked).

min_capacity.description: The lowest capacity over the span; absent when the resource declares none.

windows.description: The spans in which the resource is available, merged, with their lowest capacity.

LiveView.description: A copy of the live cell at one moment.

confidence.description: 0 to 1: how much evidence there is. Below 0.3 the subject is `new`.

frozen.description: An admin froze the score while looking into it; it does not change until unfrozen.

weight.description: The weight it has in the composite.

matched.description: The filters the resource passed, in words.

sorted_by.description: The sort key and its value.

key.description:
The provider's own key for the resource, a slug unique among its resources. The
resource's id is derived from it, so it stays the same across announcements.

name.description: A slug naming what is served: the model id, the server's name.

title.description: A display name, plain text. Defaults to the resource's name.

summary.description: One line of plain text, at most 200 characters.

description.description: Markdown, at most `BROKER_MAX_DESCRIPTION_BYTES` (16 KiB by default).

examples.description: Usage snippets: how to call the resource.

origin.description: The broker the record was announced on.

ResourceView.description: One resource, read on its own.

cache_write_5m.description: The broker's `cache_write`: gw names the five-minute write its default.

per_server_tool_call.description: The broker's `per_call` (a tool or MCP call).

FeedEntry.description: The rates gw's tracker reads; each optional.

cache_write_5m.description: The broker's `cache_write`: gw names the five-minute write its default.

per_server_tool_call.description: The broker's `per_call` (a tool or MCP call).

FeedRates.description: The rates gw's tracker reads; each optional.

cache_write_5m.description: The broker's `cache_write`: gw names the five-minute write its default.

per_server_tool_call.description: The broker's `per_call` (a tool or MCP call).

FeedTier.description: The rates gw's tracker reads; each optional.

FeedWindow.description: Hours in which a variant applies: ISO weekdays and `HH:MM-HH:MM` spans in UTC.

profile.description: The profile; the inventory only when the caller may see it.

resources.description: The provider's resources the caller may see: id, kind, name, summary.

ProviderView.description: A provider, read on its own.

price_charged.description: What was charged for one unit of `rate` (per million tokens for token rates).

at.description: When the call was made; now by default.

oneOf.description: The caller's own mistake: does not count against the resource.
Refused although the resource said it had capacity.

Outcome.description: How a call ended, as the caller reports it.

refused.description: Reports that did not count, by their position, with the reason.

comment.description: Kept for admins only, never shown to other callers.

ticket.description: The ticket the client presented to the provider.

ClientReportKind.description: What a provider reports about a client.

Timeline.description: Prices and availability of one resource over a span: the next seven days by default.

ProviderRow.description: A provider, briefly, as it appears with each resource.

Pending.description: A provider waiting for approval, with what it tried to announce.

LeaseInfo.description: A lease and what it covers.

principal.description: Who the entries belong to; `static:<provider name>` by default.

verified.description: Whether the broker vouches for the provider.

StaticProvider.description: A provider and its resources as a catalogue file or the state directory holds them.

Side.description: The side of a score: providers and their resources are rated as sellers, clients as buyers.

bearer.description: A pacod-id access token or service-account token (pidt_…); in open mode BROKER_ADMIN_TOKEN for the admin API
